product.insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

source.document_label: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Star Health And Allied Insurance Co Ltd. Policy Wordings V.14/2025

segmentation_rule: One independently source-supported governable insurance proposition per normative unit; source expression determines boundaries, not target ontology shape.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: Room Rent, Boarding and Nursing expenses are covered up to 2% of Sum Insured subject to maximum INR 5,000 per day.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: The hospitalization room/boarding/nursing benefit is limited to 2% of Sum Insured subject to a maximum of INR 5,000 per day.
atomic_units.scope_note: Room-rent semantic implementation remains deferred from the first MO-028C limit slice.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: ICU/ICCU expenses are covered up to 5% of Sum Insured subject to maximum INR 10,000 per day.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: The ICU/ICCU benefit is limited to 5% of Sum Insured subject to a maximum of INR 10,000 per day.
atomic_units.scope_note: ICU/room semantic implementation remains deferred from the first MO-028C limit slice.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: Road Ambulance expenses are subject to a maximum INR 2,000 per hospitalization.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: The Road Ambulance benefit has a fixed maximum of INR 2,000 per hospitalization.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: When room/ICU/ICCU rates exceed the allowed limits, other hospital expenses except medicines are reimbursed in the same proportion as admissible daily room/ICU rate to actual daily rate.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Exceeding the governed room/ICU/ICCU daily limit triggers proportionate reduction of other hospital expenses except medicines, based on admissible-to-actual daily room/ICU rate.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: AYUSH inpatient treatment is covered during each Policy Year up to the Sum Insured specified in the Policy Schedule.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: AYUSH inpatient treatment is covered up to the governed Sum Insured during each Policy Year.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: Cataract treatment is limited to 25% of Sum Insured or INR 40,000 whichever is lower, per each eye in one Policy Year.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Cataract treatment is limited to 25% of Sum Insured with a currency ceiling of INR 40,000, taking the lower value, per eye in one Policy Year.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: The listed procedures are covered as inpatient/day-care treatment up to 50% of Sum Insured during the Policy Period.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: A governed group of listed modern procedures shares a benefit limit of 50% of Sum Insured during the Policy Period.

atomic_units.anchored_excerpt_summary: Each and every claim is subject to 5% co-payment applicable to the admissible and payable claim amount; amount payable is after deduction of co-payment.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Every claim is subject to a 5% co-payment applied to the admissible/payable claim amount, and the payable amount is after co-payment deduction.

decision.reason: Benefit identity is load-bearing for limit semantics and cross-product comparison; establish minimal governed benefit-concept identity before implementing limit mechanics.
